headline: Sources: Eagles' Jalen Hurts, out indefinitely with blood clot, not planned for IR
body: The Eagles are not planning to put Jalen Hurts on injured reserve, sources told ESPN, even as he remains sidelined indefinitely with a superficial blood clot.

headline: Cardinals 'do what's right,' rule RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) out vs. Rams
body: The Cardinals say they're doing "what's right" for RB Jeremiyah Love by ruling the prized rookie out for Sunday's game against the Rams due to his injured left ankle.

headline: Seahawks sticking with Sam Darnold as starter despite INTs
body: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald is standing behind Sam Darnold as the team's starting quarterback despite his seven interceptions over the past four games.

headline: Ravens rule out QB Lamar Jackson; Tyler Huntley to start vs. Browns

headline: Jets rookie WR Omar Cooper Jr. to return vs. Patriots; RB Hall, WR Mitchell out
